pwa.dodaj_dogtrainer_do_ekranu_glownego: Add DogTrainer to your home screen
pwa.aplikacja_otworzy_sie_jak_zwykla_na: The app opens like a regular one, full screen, and can send you notifications.
pwa.ios_steps: Tap Share (the square with an arrow), then Add to Home Screen. Only then will you get push notifications on iPhone.
